title: Flyweight Pattern: Shared Objects for Memory Efficiency
title_es: Patrón Flyweight: Objetos Compartidos para Memoria
description: Use the Flyweight pattern to share object state and cut memory usage. Python, JavaScript, and Java examples with factory caching and real trade-offs.
description_es: Usá el patrón Flyweight para compartir estado de objetos y reducir memoria. Ejemplos en Python, JavaScript y Java, cache de fábrica y trade-offs reales.
